nodes.title: Roshan Kumar Gupta
nodes.description: Research Engineer and Systems Architect specializing in High-Performance Computing (HPC), GPU acceleration (C++/CUDA), and Physics-Constrained Machine Learning. Currently targeting Developer Technology Engineer roles.

nodes.title: Education & Identity
nodes.description: Academic background and core identity. Balancing formal B.Tech Computer Science coursework with independent, grant-funded systems research.

nodes.title: Experience & Milestones
nodes.description: Key career milestones, internships, and awards. Highlights include securing venture funding, enterprise IT experience, and winning national hackathons.

nodes.title: Architectural Projects
nodes.description: Flagship engineering projects spanning GPU-accelerated storage, quantum computing research, and physics-constrained deep learning pipelines.

nodes.title: Core Technical Skills
nodes.description: Core technical stack and competencies. Focused on low-level systems programming, AI infrastructure, and 3D web architecture.

nodes.title: FieldChain GPU Storage
nodes.description: A GPU-accelerated storage integrity system for NVMe arrays. Uses custom CUDA/Vulkan kernels to validate cryptographic data at 166.86 GiB/s, bypassing CPU bottlenecks.

nodes.title: Roshan Architecture
nodes.description: A deterministic memory framework and architectural philosophy focused on hardware constraints, memory-aligned execution, and Small Form Factor (SFF) workstation optimization.

nodes.title: Project TARS API
nodes.description: A physics-constrained machine learning pipeline that processes NASA TESS data to discover exoplanets. Funded by a $5,500 grant from Emergent Ventures.

nodes.title: QUANTA Thesis
nodes.description: Research initiative and paper defining an experimental law for the signal-to-noise limit of qubits in quantum computing. Drafted under academic mentorship.

nodes.title: Cryptic DAO Dashboard
nodes.description: A decentralized Web3 Treasury and DeFi Investment Manager. Won the ZeroToOne Hackathon by providing a seamless UI for managing decentralized assets.

nodes.title: Safety Pod App
nodes.description: A mobile-first ecosystem concept designed for personal security, utilizing low-latency signaling and real-time routing algorithms.

nodes.title: High-Performance Systems
nodes.description: Low-level programming in C/C++, CUDA, and Vulkan. Focused on memory optimization, parallel threading, and maximizing GPU hardware utilization.

nodes.title: Physics-Constrained ML
nodes.description: Designing neural networks that are constrained by actual physical laws (like orbital mechanics) rather than just statistical pattern matching.

nodes.title: AI Infrastructure
nodes.description: Building and deploying AI infrastructure, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, vector databases, and local Large Language Models (LLMs).

nodes.title: Web & UI Architecture
nodes.description: Developing immersive 3D web interfaces using React, WebGL, and Three.js to visualize complex data structures and neural network architectures.

nodes.title: B.Tech Computer Science
nodes.description: Currently pursuing a B.Tech in Computer Science (UID: 25BCS10109), maintaining a strong academic foundation while serving as Department Student Representative.

nodes.title: Chandigarh University
nodes.description: Balancing rigorous university coursework at Chandigarh University with independent, bleeding-edge research in high-performance computing.

nodes.title: L&T Intern
nodes.description: Navigating enterprise-scale engineering operations. Managed high-level IT infrastructure, networking, and systems support for an enterprise environment.

nodes.title: Emergent Ventures Grantee
nodes.description: Awarded a competitive $5,500 grant from Emergent Ventures (recognized by Tyler Cowen) to fund independent research and hardware for Project TARS.

nodes.title: CUDA Multi-Threading
nodes.description: Utilizing direct warp scheduling and memory-aligned execution in CUDA to achieve maximum parallel processing efficiency on NVIDIA GPUs.

nodes.title: PCIe 4.0 Streaming
nodes.description: Optimizing data pipelines to saturate PCIe Gen4 theoretical bandwidth limits, enabling zero-copy data streaming for massive datasets.

nodes.title: Advanced Memory Mgmt
nodes.description: Transitioning memory layouts from Array of Structures (AoS) to Structure of Arrays (SoA) to eliminate warp divergence and improve GPU cache hit rates.

nodes.title: Deterministic Runtimes
nodes.description: Writing predictive, bounded execution flows in C++ that guarantee stable memory allocation and exact execution times.

nodes.title: NASA TESS Light Curves
nodes.description: Processing massive, noisy time-series photometric data from the NASA TESS mission to extract valid exoplanet transit signals.

nodes.title: Exoplanet Iterations
nodes.description: Applying physical constraints of celestial mechanics and orbital geometry to validate exoplanet candidates and reject false positives.

nodes.title: SIMD Instructions
nodes.description: Leveraging Single Instruction, Multiple Data (SIMD) pipelines to process large blocks of cryptographic data simultaneously.

nodes.title: Warp Scheduling
nodes.description: Managing GPU thread blocks (warps) to ensure continuous, non-divergent execution and maximum hardware utilization.

nodes.title: C / C++
nodes.description: High-performance systems programming focusing on pointer arithmetic, manual memory management, and optimizing cache line boundaries.

nodes.title: Vulkan Pipelines
nodes.description: Using custom Vulkan compute shaders to bind arithmetic directly to memory pipelines, avoiding standard driver overhead.

nodes.title: PyTorch
nodes.description: Building and training deep learning models, specifically designing custom loss functions that penalize physically impossible outputs.

nodes.title: Tensor Operations
nodes.description: Mapping high-dimensional data into optimized tensor structures for fast, hardware-accelerated matrix multiplication.

nodes.title: Backpropagation
nodes.description: Implementing custom backpropagation logic to correct neural networks based on physical boundary constraints rather than just statistical error.

nodes.title: Physics-Informed NNs
nodes.description: Physics-Informed Neural Networks. Integrating differential equations into the training process to solve complex scientific problems.

nodes.title: Large Language Models
nodes.description: Integrating Large Language Models into local pipelines for unstructured data parsing and semantic reasoning tasks.

nodes.title: RAG Architecture
nodes.description: Building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to ground AI responses in factual, domain-specific engineering data.

nodes.title: Vector Embeddings
nodes.description: Implementing vector databases and embedding models to enable sub-millisecond semantic search and data retrieval.

nodes.title: React.js
nodes.description: Using React.js to manage complex state and build dynamic user interfaces that sit on top of heavy 3D WebGL canvases.

nodes.title: WebGL
nodes.description: Accessing low-level GPU rendering pipelines in the browser to build high-performance 3D data visualizations.

nodes.title: Three.js
nodes.description: Utilizing Three.js to translate complex mathematical backend graphs into interactive, spatial 3D environments.

nodes.title: GF(2^31-1) Prime Math
nodes.description: Applying GF(2^31-1) Prime field mathematics to optimize cryptographic packing and avoid modulus bias in data storage.

nodes.title: Event Evidence Aggregator
nodes.description: Developed the Event Evidence Aggregator, an algorithm to compare transit shapes and stabilize signal detection in sparse datasets.

nodes.title: ECHO Physics Validator
nodes.description: Built the ECHO Physics Validator, a heuristic system that rejects >91% of false-positive periodic signals by enforcing solid-body physics.

nodes.title: SFF Hardware Builds
nodes.description: Designing and building custom Small Form Factor (SFF) workstations to maximize local compute power for AI and systems development.

nodes.title: HSA* Routing Engine
nodes.description: Developed HSA*, a proprietary, highly optimized pathfinding algorithm designed for real-time, safety-aware navigation. Peaked at 97µs path calculation.

nodes.title: Geometric Loss Functions
nodes.description: Creating custom geometric loss functions that penalize machine learning models when they violate known mathematical and physical laws.

nodes.title: Selective Depth Acquisition
nodes.description: A cognitive methodology of acquiring deep technical mastery just-in-time to solve high-leverage bottlenecks. Focuses on capability over academic completeness.

nodes.title: Hardware-Sympathetic Software
nodes.description: The philosophy of treating software as a physical constraint acting upon silicon. Every architectural decision is guided by memory alignment and throughput.

nodes.title: Top-Down Cognitive Architecture
nodes.description: Macro-to-micro systems thinking. Identifying structural hardware limits before descending into algorithmic logic and implementation details.
